results.name: the level validates
results.note: 377 tiles, 23 carriers, 4 hooks, 17 arms, 13 rovers, 14 crate drops, 56 salvage

results.name: dry physics is Level 1's: a held jump rises 3 tiles
every carrier ride is clear of solid scenery (gratings in hubs are hatches it lifts him through)
every ride, and every destination, is clear of every hazard (outside the boss)
walking into a hovering gripper: picked up, no choice, set down on his feet at its next destination, unhurt
each grab sends him to the next destination on the list, round and round
jumping over the gripper gets him past it
nothing hurts him while a carrier holds him
a carrier rests at home after a ride before it can grab again
the camera slows carriers and hooks, never Mike
results.note: ride 2.05s normally, 4.42s while filming; running speed unchanged

results.name: a hook: jump into the handle, ride the rail, Jump lets go with a hop onto the far deck
Down lets go of a hook without a hop
hazard arms hurt only while their light is red
results.note: 398 red and 537 safe instants sampled; a1 hurt him only while red

results.name: a floor rover hurts on contact; a low rover can be jumped
crates hurt only while falling
belts carry him, and reversing belts reverse on machine time
the route log records a lane once he stands on it
every round starts with the route broken, and can be put right
results.note: round 1: 2 turns, round 2: 5 turns, round 3: 7 turns

results.name: the arena door shuts behind him when the Teach Cell wakes, and a checkpoint inside it is lit
the arm carries its crate along the route and drops it where the route breaks
results.note: the crate fell at waypoint F

results.name: a crate it drops hurts him if he stands under the break
holding Fix at a dial for 2.2 s turns it to its next exit, filming or not; each turn needs a new hold
after each trip the arm warns, then sweeps one level of the cell: it hurts him there and nowhere else; no level is safe from all three
round 2 has two arms, each working from its own chute
a put-right route delivers the crate; the round is done and the next one begins
in round 3, a blue crate at the orange pallet is dropped, not delivered
a lost life restarts the round with its dials as they were, and he comes back inside the cell
all three rounds put right: the arm is restored, the exit opens and the level is won
a save keeps the round, the route log and the pickups; a save after the fix resumes the ending
